result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but the promotional banner has a serious text-contrast problem (white text on a pale green background), and the horizontal restaurant carousel clips card content at the right edge without a clear scroll affordance.

issues.description: In the '3 free deliveries for you' banner, the white heading and the 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' subtext sit on a very light green background, resulting in very low color contrast that is hard to read and fails WCAG contrast guidelines.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker/more saturated banner background or switch the text to a dark color (e.g., dark green/black) so the heading and promo code meet at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right screen edge with the title truncated and no visible scroll indicator, which can make it unclear that the row is horizontally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle scroll affordance such as a fade/gradient at the right edge, peeking next card, or horizontal scroll indicator, and ensure truncated titles use an ellipsis consistently.
